title: Workspace identity wall

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Make a shared belief part of a place because repeated physical encounters can connect a team to its purpose.
strategic_value: A large collaboration statement surrounded by editing motifs can carry Figma’s campaign into the workspace.
demonstration: A frontal room view shows a pegboard wall with black campaign lettering, multicolor stars, cursors, selection frame and the Figma mark above.
practical_value: Test whether the digital identity’s symbols remain clear at architectural scale.

content_islands.name: Wall statement
content_islands.spec: Center large three-line black lettering on the perforated wood wall.

content_islands.name: Identity motifs
content_islands.spec: Surround and overlap the letters with stars, pointers and a blue selection frame; place the logo above.

content_islands.name: Room setting
content_islands.spec: Retain seating and table in front to establish environmental scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The room image applies the campaign line and editing motifs to a large physical wall.
